tagline: Exams on your classroom network. No cloud, no accounts.
brief: A self-contained exam server in one binary for the classroom: no cloud, no installs. The logo had to be discreet — the exam and the institution are the protagonists — calm under the clock and recognisable at 16 px.
criteria: Success: works at 16 px, in one ink, on light and dark, and never competes with the institution's logo.
label: Brand

concepts.name: Registro
concepts.idea: ASSESS sits on a record rule; the magenta block closes the row.
rationale: Comes from the Mesa de luz system: sheet, rule, ink and one magenta.
Works from 16 px to a poster: tile, mark and wordmark are one system.
The name stays discreet; the exam and the institution remain the protagonists.
In one ink, the block merges with the rule into a heavier full stop.

recommendation: Registro: the name sits on a line and the magenta block is the student's mark. The identity is deliberately quiet: it does not compete with the exam or the institution's logo.
next_steps: The kit includes the wordmark, mark, app icon, one-ink and reversed versions.
Keep the logo discreet: the exam and the institution remain the protagonists.
Before registering the mark, run a clearance search.
